name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: The How-to guide now covers Buy/Sell AUD — the entry type for tracking your AUD currency float, including the optional exchange-rate note.
It also explains the "Buy AUD" withdrawal tick-box: how a withdrawal can draw from your Buy/Sell AUD balance instead of a bank, with a worked example and an updated chart.
As always, available in English, 中文 (Chinese) and ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer).
